description:
The new generation of Blue Pig, our gravity led hardcore steel 27.5’’ weapon. The Blue Pig has been in the Ragley stables from day one, 15 years later and it’s still leading the pack with its hardcore credentials and all-day riding capabilities. A frame that relishes in abuse, inspires confidence when things get gnarly and spraying loam but still happily munches up the miles when in the saddle pedalling.
With hardtails being pushed harder and faster than ever before we have tweaked the trusted Ragley recipe for modern tastes. Our bikes have always been at the forefront of fun versatile hardcore hardtails and with a sprinkle of love with the same Ragley ingredients the fun has now been cranked up to 11. The Blue Pig set the standard for hardcore hardtails and continues to step ahead and raise the bar. Striking a balance between hardcore capabilities and all-day riding. The Blue Pig headtube has now been slackened to 63˚ and complimented with a shorter seattube to drop your saddle further, giving you even more commanding control when the trail gets steep, rowdy or airborne. An increased reach and 5mm lower BB gives you highspeed confidence and technical stability. Then for when you bang the saddle back up to crunch some miles, the steeper 75˚ seat-angle puts you in a comfortable, balanced and efficient pedalling position. More control and more fun like no other, with the updated geometry the Blue Pig is at home being piloted at an Enduro Race, epics into the mountains, sweet flat-out singletrack and smashing laps at your favourite trail centre or bike park. All Ragley Steel frames are now ED Coated to prevent rust. This process of dipping the frame into electrically charged paint bath ensures the frame inside and out is perfectly protected in a uniform robust coating. The Blue Pig frame features all the modern no-nonsense fitting standards for easy serviceability. ISCG05 tabs, 44mm headtube, internal dropper routing, threaded BB and Boost 148x12mm rear wheel fitting. Engineered from custom triple butted 4130 Chromoly Steel tubing, offering a predictable playful ride and the luxury of steel compliance and comfort.
